title: Navigating Ideation Space: Decomposed Conceptual Representations for Positioning Scientific Ideas
abstract: arXiv:2601.08901v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scientific discovery requires new ideas to be situated within an ever-expanding landscape of existing knowledge. An emerging challenge is how to identify conceptually relevant prior work from rapidly growing literature, and assess how a new idea differentiates from existing research. Current embedding approaches typically conflate distinct conceptual aspects into single representations and cannot support fine-grained retrieval; meanwhile, LLM-based evaluators are subject to sycophancy biases, failing to provide discriminative novelty assessment. We introduce the Ideation Space, a structured representation that decomposes scientific knowledge into three distinct dimensions learned through contrastive training. Our framework enables principled measurement of conceptual distance between ideas and modeling of ideation transitions that capture the logical connections within an idea. tldr: 该论文提出“构思空间”这一结构化表示，通过对比训练将科学知识分解为三个独立维度，实现了科学思想间概念距离的原则性测量与具有区分性的新颖性评估，帮助研究者精确定位新想法相对于现有研究的差异。
